status: PREPARED_NOT_AUTHORISED. No game of this plan has been played. Before any game: operator approval of the budget, then a journal entry 'dev-preregistered' with this file's sha256.
purpose: Single-factor tests of three planner corrections for problems the V4 pilot exposed in the honest (EV) planner. Development evidence only: the final holdout 65001-65060 stays untouched until a candidate is frozen.

seeds.note: fresh development seeds: not used or reserved by V1-V4 (V4 pilot 64001-64030, V4 holdout 65001-65060, smoke 99001-99399)

control.planner: ev-teleport-v4.1 defaults (exactly the V4 pilot candidate)

factors.mechanism: greedy ties broken in board-coordinate order: for AI pieces low x = nearest the goal, for Human pieces = farthest. Mirror check: 7/40 chosen plans and 16/40 move lists differ between a position and its mirror; 0/40 with K1

predictions.definition: |win rate as Human side - win rate as AI side| for K1 vs E0 head-to-head with mirrored seats

factors.mechanism: the whole-turn look-ahead lets the opponent only move, never place. In 60/60 EV games the second mover captured on turn 2 (120 pieces), every capture through the trap it had just placed; the first mover's plan predicted +4.5, the real value after turn 2 was -5.0. K2 predicts -5.0 exactly
factors.caveat: on the probed turn-1 positions K2 corrects the prediction but does not change the opening; it is still a single-factor test of the opponent model

factors.component: planner-search (candidate set) + executor plays the chosen move prefix
factors.mechanism: every whole-turn candidate moves greedily to the end, so holding pieces back is never compared. Against the real EV reply, 0 moves after the conveyor placement scored -3.3 versus -5.0 for the full rush (probe)
factors.requires: executor change: play the chosen candidate's moves (not a fresh greedy re-plan) up to the first random move. Not implemented yet

notTestedYet: Opening temperature / candidate-scale changes: deferred until K2 / K3 results, because the collapse (one candidate inside the 0.6 window on every turn 1, margin 4.8) may change with them.

Rules-level levers (Kane's S3, S4): S3 = 1 limits the first mover to 1 action on turn 1. Under EV the probe shows 1 move is LESS exposed than 3 (-4.2 vs -5.0), so S3 may RAISE the first-mover rate there, the opposite of Kane's prediction. Kane's original prediction stays as written; any rescoped S3 test must be registered as a new, two-sided hypothesis with Claude/operator provenance, separate from Kane's.

design.selfPlay: E0, K1, K2, K3 each EV-vs-EV on seeds 66001-66030 x both first movers = 60 games per arm, paired by seed with E0
design.headToHead: K1 vs E0 with mirrored seats and first-mover order on 66001-66015 = 60 games (the asymmetry test)
design.uncertainty: paired-by-seed bootstrap 95% (V3 pairedDiff), Wilson 95% for rates
design.gates: V4 pilot gates G1-G6 against E0 (length, turn limit, edge, diversity, counterplay, safety) plus: information fairness unchanged (foresight interval contains 0), mirror mismatch 0 for K1
design.selection: at most one factor (or a combination only after each has its own result) is frozen into a V4.2 candidate; that frozen candidate, not any of these arms, is what the holdout 65001-65060 evaluates later
